digest.component_or_area: test_wiki_render_corpus unit tests / wiki rendering pipeline
propositions: Each xdist worker re-renders all 178 corpus bodies (~884 pandoc spawns) independently due to process-local lru_cache, tripling CPU work under -n 3 --dist worksteal
Three test consumers each pay a full 42-45s fill cost instead of one shared fill under parallel xdist execution, wasting ~56s of CPU re-deriving identical immutable artifacts
The three fixed-point tests recompute pass-1 renders bit-for-bit identical to values already cached by _rendered(), duplicating ~half their runtime
Cross-worker shared session-scoped artifact keyed by SHA-256 digest of corpus JSON, wiki_render source, and pandoc executable eliminates per-worker cache fills
Sharded per-stratum artifacts with PYTEST_XDIST_WORKER-rotated probe order and os.mkdir-based mutual exclusion allow concurrent fill with one stratum of wall time instead of whole corpus
Deadline-based fallback (150s) on orphaned locks degrades to per-worker rendering instead of deadlocking when a winner crashes, staying inside 300s timeout guard
